notes: The launcher looked cheap and this is the fix for why, not a repaint. Everything was inline literals - about 200 of them - so there was no design system to be consistent with. There is now: one palette, one type scale, one spacing scale, one set of springs. Three things were actually wrong. Cards sat 18 RGB points off the background, which measures fine and collapses into one flat grey on this panel, so a card is now separated three ways at once - a bigger tonal step, a gradient inside it, and a hairline border. Text was far too small: labels were written at 8sp and then the 0.8 interface scale took them to about 6.4sp on a 13 inch screen, so the whole scale is up roughly 1.8x with a hard floor. And nothing moved - one animation in 8600 lines - so gauges, presses, page state and the reverse handover are all on springs now. Home is rebuilt. The swipe pager is gone: one app per page photographs well and is hostile while driving, since reaching the fifth app was five swipes and five glances off the road. Every favourite is on screen at once now. CarPlay gets its own tile rather than being one of eight equal icons, because that is what this deck is actually for. The Ranger render is deleted. It was never a cutout - it was a rectangular crop of a photo with road surface, lane markings and a visible seam, upscaled from a 206px source, and no better photo would have fixed that. Reverse now hands the left column over to the parking sensors instead, drawn where they physically are with a steering-predicted guide path, and hands back when you shift out. Two signals this van genuinely reports, doing real work. Also: the Light theme was broken and now is not, Settings prints the panel spec so I can finally see this screen without flashing your deck, and the APK is 167KB smaller.
